explanations: When wrap() gets an error that is already an AppError, it copies the code and retryable flag but sets the new error's cause to err.cause instead of err. The error being wrapped drops out of the chain, along with its context: the carrier adapter's { carrier, httpStatus, carrierRequestId } when the label service wraps it, then the label service's { shipmentId, orderId } when the wave wraps it. mergedContext, toLogRecord and the wave report all walk the cause chain, so they can't see those fields. Codes and retries kept working because they were copied. Setting cause: err makes each wrap add a layer instead of replacing one, so the whole chain and every layer's context are still there at the top.
